chunks.head: at best
chunks.note: 表示往最好里说也不过如此

literal.note_cn: 此处 at best 合起来意为“充其量”

chunks.ex_en: The old car is worth 500 dollars at best.
chunks.ex_cn: 这辆旧车最多值五百美元。

chunks.head: be done with it
chunks.note: 把某事做完、彻底摆脱它
chunks.ex_en: I want to finish the report today and be done with it.
chunks.ex_cn: 我想今天把报告写完，一了百了。

chunks.head: treat like a dog
chunks.note: 指粗暴、轻蔑地对待某人
chunks.ex_en: Nobody should treat a worker like a dog.
chunks.ex_cn: 谁也不该把工人当狗一样使唤。

chunks.head: turn one's back
chunks.note: 既可指字面转身，也比喻不理睬、抛弃
chunks.ex_en: Don't turn your back on a friend in trouble.
chunks.ex_cn: 朋友有难时别背弃他。

chunks.head: run away from home
chunks.ex_en: The angry boy threatened to run away from home.
chunks.ex_cn: 那个生气的男孩扬言要离家出走。

chunks.head: get ready
chunks.ex_en: Get ready, the bus leaves in five minutes.
chunks.ex_cn: 准备好，公交五分钟后就走。

chunks.head: near at hand
chunks.note: 固定短语，指空间上近或时间上将至
chunks.ex_en: Keep a pen near at hand while you read.
chunks.ex_cn: 看书时把笔放在手边。

chunks.head: scratch one's head
chunks.ex_en: The hard puzzle made everyone scratch their heads.
chunks.ex_cn: 这道难题让大家直挠头。

chunks.head: look upon as
chunks.ex_en: They look upon her as their leader.
chunks.ex_cn: 他们把她视为领袖。

chunks.head: many a time
chunks.note: 固定说法，等于 many times，后接单数
chunks.ex_en: I have told him many a time to be careful.
chunks.ex_cn: 我已经多次叫他小心了。

chunks.head: occur to sb
chunks.note: 念头突然出现在某人脑中
chunks.ex_en: It never occurred to me that she was lying.
chunks.ex_cn: 我从没想到她在撒谎。

chunks.head: puzzle over
chunks.note: 为弄懂某事而反复思索
chunks.ex_en: She puzzled over the math problem for an hour.
chunks.ex_cn: 她对着那道数学题苦想了一个小时。

chunks.head: in a fright
chunks.ex_en: The cat ran off in a fright when the door slammed.
chunks.ex_cn: 门砰地关上，猫受惊跑开了。

chunks.head: give up

literal.note_cn: give up 合起来意为“放弃”

chunks.ex_en: Never give up when things get hard.
chunks.ex_cn: 事情变难时也绝不放弃。

chunks.head: might as well
chunks.ex_en: It's raining, so we might as well stay home.
chunks.ex_cn: 下雨了，我们不如待在家里。

chunks.head: fall short
chunks.note: 常搭配 of，表示达不到某标准
chunks.ex_en: Our sales fell short of the target this month.
chunks.ex_cn: 这个月我们的销售没达到目标。

chunks.head: by the book
chunks.note: 严格按规则或说明去做
chunks.ex_en: The new manager does everything by the book.
chunks.ex_cn: 新经理凡事都照章办事。

chunks.head: get the hang of
chunks.ex_en: After a week, I got the hang of the new software.
chunks.ex_cn: 一周后，我掌握了新软件的用法。

chunks.head: get the worst of it
chunks.note: 在较量或争执中处于劣势
chunks.ex_en: In every argument with her, he gets the worst of it.
chunks.ex_cn: 每次跟她争论，他都落下风。

chunks.head: get around
chunks.note: 此处指绕开、避开某种约束
chunks.ex_en: There is no getting around the rules.
chunks.ex_cn: 这些规矩绕不过去。

skipped: in happy accord with（分隔+过于书面）
drift insensibly back into（被 insensibly 分隔，一次性）
go on the warpath（此处半字面写印第安人出征，易误导）
would rather ... than（语法结构，非词汇语块）
at a time（此处 long at a time 用法特殊）
throw away / tossed away（基础，且多处被分隔）
went off（一词多义，此处仅“离去”）
spring up（此处字面“跳起来”，一次性）
